children.value:
The entries below consolidate the works cited in the chapters and
supporting matter. Papers on resource estimates describe their stated
models and assumptions; they are not evidence that this book’s companion
circuits have performed those calculations. Software sources and
language specifications are identified separately from algorithm papers.

This is a language-design source, not a guarantee about a particular
current compiler accepting every emitted program.

“OpenQASM 3: A Broader and Deeper Quantum Assembly Language.”

PhD thesis, California Institute of Technology (1997).

PySCF User Guide: Molecular Integrals and

API documentation supplements the PySCF program paper above; the
companion’s environment and input metadata identify the calculation.

Hoeffding, W. “Probability Inequalities for Sums of Bounded Random
Variables.”
Journal of the American Statistical Association

The concentration bound used for independent bounded measurement
outcomes; it is not a bound on ansatz or model error.
